updates.imgAlt: Announcement photo of completion of Sonic 4 filming, showing director Jeff Fowler holding the clapperboard in front of the Metal Sonic prop
updates.blurb: Jeff Fowler announces completion of the filming of Sonic 4.

updates.imgAlt: Promotional image of an IMAX theater
updates.blurb: Sonic 4 is announced to have wide IMAX release.
Early footage of Sonic 4 is shown at CinemaCon, featuring Robotnik. "Robotnik! Saves! World!"

updates.imgAlt: Collage of photos of Jim Carrey, Nick Offerman, Matt Berry, and Richard Ayoade
updates.blurb: Full cast of Sonic 4 announced, with Jim Carrey and Keanu Reeves returning and Nick Offerman, Matt Berry, and Richard Ayoade joining. Offerman, as well as Ben Kingsley, have voice roles.
Entertainment journalist Jeff Sneider reports Ben Kingsley as cast member of Sonic 4.

updates.imgAlt: Announcement photo of Sonic 4 filming, showing director Jeff Fowler holding Amy's hammer and the large number 4
updates.blurb: Jeff Fowler announces start of filming of Sonic 4.

updates.imgAlt: Announcement photo of Amy's voice actor in Sonic 4, showing Ben Schwartz and Kristen Bell holding small Funko Pops of Sonic and Amy
updates.blurb: Amy's voice actor in Sonic 4 is announced to be Kristen Bell.
